description: This file defines a Java interface named FilteredTopic, which represents a filtered view over a Topic with optional filtering criteria and extra field selectors. It provides methods to retrieve the topic, namespaces, filter string, enrichment selectors, and a deprecated method to check if a filter is present.

classes.name: FilteredTopic
classes.description: An interface that wraps a Topic with optional filters and extra field selectors, used to filter and enrich signals in a messaging or event system.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the underlying Topic object associated with this FilteredTopic.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns a list of namespace strings for which the filter applies; empty list means all namespaces.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the filter query string, if present.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if a filter exists; should use getFilter().isPresent() instead.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing a JsonFieldSelector to specify extra fields for signal enrichment.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FilteredTopic.
